requirement: Role-variable releases: /ops opens the design-system lock for a release whose v8 preview reading is clean, and keeps it shut while VARS-1 or MODE-3 fails

oracle.ref: PR #1398 (feat); fix evidence: Unit tests over the /ops lock derivation and the VARS-1, MODE-3 and measurement readers that the role-variable batch added or changed
oracle.invariant: S1: only an all-pass check opens the template (code ds-ready); every other state keeps it shut with its own code. S2: VARS-1 is must-fix for every CMS; no scan for this version is Not scanned yet and holds Publish; missing roles and literals fail naming file, line and component; a clean scan passes. S3: MODE-3 is must-fix for every CMS and fails on each one-look mismatch; modes: true passes; a one-look template is not applicable. S4: the newest in-tree preview reading wins over the release VERIFICATION.json of the same run.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
